verdict.rationale: AMD's GPU architecture spec table lists the MI325X (CDNA3, gfx942) with a 256 figure, which reads as 256 GB of VRAM, enough to hold a 70B-class quantized model on a single GPU. ROCm docs also cover vLLM and SGLang inference recipes, so single-node LLM inference is a documented path. However, the evidence shows no memory-bandwidth figure, the spec row lacks visible column labels, and nothing demonstrates a 70B model actually running. Missing for 10: published memory bandwidth, explicitly labeled VRAM capacity, and first-party or hands-on evidence of 70B quantized inference throughput.
